articles.title: She had trouble paying the rent and built herself a 15-square-meter tiny house on wheels for $30,000: she travels across the United States spending $700 on gas
articles.standfirst: Jenna K. spends a year creating her own home on wheels
articles.summary: Jenna K. spends a year creating her own home on wheels
articles.body:
There are decisions in a person’s life that are important, since they shape the future and how they will devote the rest of their days. Jenna K , in an interview for People magazine, revealed how she decided to leave her job and change course because she was having serious trouble paying the rent . For that reason, she chose to make a 180-degree turn and build her own 15-square-meter tiny house .

The young woman admits that, although she couldn’t say she was short of money, she does regret that she was never able to save because of rent payments. “So I hoped to have a house someday , but that became less and less likely. It seemed that wasn’t going to happen for a very long time,” she says.

Given this situation, Jenna K. explains that one day, after reading an article about tiny houses, she chose to follow that path: “ I built the tiny house in a relative’s backyard and then decided to leave my job and travel with it, since it was a tiny house on wheels, and make documentaries about my travels for a year”.

Trained in film, she quit her job and set off to travel the road after spending $30,000 to shape her 15-square-meter home, which weighs about 4,500 kilograms and has electricity, water, and a plumbing system. She admits that her biggest expense is gasoline , although she ended up staying for a year and a half at a campground, where she only paid for Wi-Fi while working as a host. Now, she has her online channel ‘Tiny Home Giant Journey’ and manages the social media for a tiny house company .

“My main job simply consisted of creating content for my channel and helping it grow. And it wasn’t until years later that it could fully support me without the need for a second job ,” she emphasizes.
